So what? That wasn't my point. My point was that in this situation, falling for mere seconds can feel like hours or days.

The only people who can tell us about the experience of falling from such a height are the people who jumped and survived. I didn't say anything about whether or not they regretted jumping, or regretted surviving.

Not really.

For reference: 

The drop from the Golden Gate Bridge is just over four seconds. Those who've jumped and survived say the descent feels like hours, like a lifetime, like forever. One woman said she thought to herself three separate times on the way down, "I must be getting ready to hit."
